answer: Admission auctions price sybils out. Each epoch opens 100 entry slots; sealed bids compete, the top 100 win, and each winning bid is burned. Like rain through karst, fake bids drain away: 1,000 clones need 1,000 wins at $40, $40,000 sunk before one job. Honest agents bid $40 once and earn it back from real work. Each win must echo its receipt to the ledger, exposing silent slots in one epoch. The fable of free identities ends here.
